zh.title: 台灣高鐵N700ST新車在日本福岡舉行出廠晚宴
zh.summary: 台灣高鐵2026年7月29日晚間在日本福岡舉行N700ST新型車輛出廠歡迎晚宴，活動由台灣高鐵董事長史哲主持，交通部長陳世凱代表最大股東出席。會中史哲宣布高鐵董事會捐贈2000萬日圓協助熊本地震賑災，台日政界及軌道產業代表約300人共同與會。
body: 台灣高鐵公司於2026年7月29日晚間在日本福岡舉行「台灣高鐵N700ST新型車輛出廠」歡迎晚宴，慶祝新型軌道車輛順利出廠。活動由台灣高鐵公司董事長史哲主持，交通部長陳世凱則代表最大股東出席晚宴。
本次活動吸引台日政界與軌道產業約300人參與，包含駐日代表李逸洋、多位跨黨派國會議員，以及JR東海會長金子慎與日立軌道事業執行長馬里諾等人。台灣高鐵董事長史哲並於會中宣布，高鐵董事會已決定捐贈2000萬日圓協助熊本地震災後支援。

en.title: Taiwan High Speed Rail Holds Rollout Ceremony Dinner for N700ST Trains in Fukuoka
en.summary: Taiwan High Speed Rail held a welcome dinner in Fukuoka, Japan, on July 29, 2026, to mark the rollout of its new N700ST trains. The event was hosted by Taiwan High Speed Rail Chairman Shi Che, with Minister of Transportation and Communications Chen Shih-kai attending on behalf of the company's largest shareholder. During the event, Shi Che announced that the board of directors decided to donate 20 million yen for Kumamoto earthquake relief. Around 300 participants from Taiwanese and Japanese political and rail industry sectors attended.
body: Taiwan High Speed Rail hosted a welcome dinner in Fukuoka, Japan, on July 29, 2026, to mark the factory rollout of its new N700ST trains. The ceremony was presided over by Taiwan High Speed Rail Chairman Shi Che, with Minister of Transportation and Communications Chen Shih-kai attending on behalf of the high-speed rail operator's largest shareholder.

The event brought together approximately 300 guests from Taiwanese and Japanese political and industrial sectors, including Representative to Japan Lee I-yang, lawmakers from both countries, JR Central Chairman Shin Kaneko, and Hitachi Rail CEO Giuseppe Marino. During the event, Shi Che announced that the board of directors of Taiwan High Speed Rail decided to donate 20 million yen for Kumamoto earthquake relief effort.

zh.title: 通用動力Q2營收140.9億美元 航太部門成長領先
zh.summary: 根據通用動力於2026年7月29日發布的第二季財報，公司整體營收達到140.9億美元，其中航太部門的增長速度在各業務條線中最快。這也意味著航太業務成為集團當季增長的主要引擎。
body: 通用動力在2026年7月29日公布的第二季財報中披露，公司整體營收達到140.9億美元。
財報同時指出，航太部門的增長速度在所有業務條線中最快。
航太部門的領先增長使其成為本季整體業績超越預期的主要驅動力。
公告日期為2026年7月29日，營收與增長數據均在財報中明確列示。
第二季營收數字為140.9億美元，這一數據見於2026年7月29日的財報。
航太部門增長最快的事實在財報中被明確標示。
通用動力此次財報發布日期為2026年7月29日。

en.summary: General Dynamics announced on July 29, 2026 that its second‑quarter revenue reached $14.09 billion, with the Aerospace segment posting the fastest growth among its business lines, making it the primary driver of the quarter’s performance. The report shows that the aerospace segment's growth rate was the highest of all segments, and this contributed significantly to the overall revenue beat. The second‑quarter revenue figure of $14.09 billion was disclosed in the earnings release dated July 29, 2026.

zh.title: 波音完成737-7與737-10認證飛行測試 朝2027年交機推進
zh.summary: 波音宣布已完成737 MAX家族最小型號737-7與最大型號737-10的認證飛行測試，仍預期兩款衍生機型於2026年獲得認證、2027年首架交付。
body: 波音公司已完成旗下737 MAX系列中機身最短的737-7與機身最長的737-10兩款客機的認證飛行測試。該公司在7月28日發布的第二季財報中確認此里程碑，並表示持續預期兩款衍生機型於2026年取得認證、2027年開始交付客戶。
AeroTime於7月29日報導指出，波音已完成這兩款最小與最大737 MAX客機的規劃認證飛行測試。737-7與737-10是MAX家族最後兩款等待認證的型號。
波音第二季商用飛機部門交出171架飛機，並取得包含大韓航空、達美航空與SMBC Capital在內的246架淨訂單。截至季末，公司總積壓訂單增至破紀錄的7,150億美元，其中包含超過6,200架商用飛機。

en.title: Boeing wraps up 737-7 and 737-10 certification flight tests, keeping 2027 delivery target
en.summary: Boeing has completed planned certification flight testing of the smallest and largest 737 MAX variants, the 737-7 and 737-10, and continues to anticipate certification in 2026 and first delivery in 2027 for both types.
body: Boeing has rounded off certification flight tests for the smallest and largest members of the 737 MAX family, the 737-7 and 737-10. The milestone was confirmed in the company's second-quarter earnings release on July 28, which stated that testing had been completed as of July and that Boeing continues to anticipate certification in 2026 and first delivery in 2027 for both variants.
AeroTime reported on July 29 that Boeing had completed planned certification flight tests of the two jets, noting the 737-7 and 737-10 are the last of the MAX family awaiting certification.

During the second quarter, Boeing Commercial Airplanes delivered 171 aircraft and booked 246 net orders, including business from Korean Air, Delta Air Lines and SMBC Capital. The total company backlog reached a record US$715 billion by quarter-end, including more than 6,200 commercial airplanes.
